entities.name: La Constancia Mexicana
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: La Constancia Mexicana is a museum and former textile factory located 9 km (5.6 mi) from downtown Puebla, Mexico. The factory was the first textile mill to integrate automatic machinery into the production process.
